t: You're on or beside Waterloo Bridge, which carries road and foot traffic across the Thames between Blackfriars Bridge and Hungerford Bridge. Its name commemorates the victory of the British, Dutch and Prussians at the Battle of Waterloo in 1815. It sits at a strategic bend in the river, so the views are good: Westminster, the South Bank and the London Eye to the west, and the City of London and Canary Wharf to the east. The bridge was designed by Giles Gilbert Scott, who also designed the red telephone box.
